key_insight: Creative AI Researcher (CAR) structures AI research ideation around literature grounding, iterative development, and explicit conceptual operations. It aims to make generated proposals easier to connect to the scientific work that inspired them.
problem_solved: Language models can generate plausible research ideas, but it remains unclear which processes make those ideas effective and how novel proposals emerge from prior research.
method: Construct a semantic knowledge graph from retrieved scientific literature.
Equip an ideation agent with graph-retrieval tools to ground proposals in existing research.
Combine iterative idea development with explicit conceptual operators to structure ideation.
impact: CAR offers a framework for more grounded and traceable AI-assisted research brainstorming. The supplied abstract is truncated, so it does not establish measured improvements or evaluation outcomes.
visual_elements: Pipeline diagram: retrieved papers → semantic knowledge graph → ideation agent → research proposal.
Knowledge graph showing connections among papers, concepts, and generated ideas.
Iteration loop illustrating repeated idea development.
Provenance trail linking a proposal to its source literature and conceptual transformations.
paper_title: Ground, Iterate, Trace: Decomposing AI Research Ideation
paper_authors: Samson Yu, Qiran Zou, Jing Yu Lim, Rushi Shah, Anirudh Goyal
